proposed_comments.title: State the owner-thread requirement on Initialize

confidence.rationale: Exact source captures the current dispatcher and later dereferences it; the single launch caller is correct. The literal is documentation only.

proposed_comments.body:
### State the owner-thread requirement on Initialize

**Severity:** `low` (non-blocking API documentation)

Please document that `Initialize` must run on the palette window's UI thread. It captures `DispatcherQueue.GetForCurrentThread()`, and later settings notifications use that captured queue to refresh the shared snapshot.

The current `App.OnLaunched` call already follows this lifecycle. This makes the existing precondition visible to future callers; it does not allege concurrent initialization today or request a new lock, fallback dispatcher, or resource cache.

```suggestion
    /// <summary>Starts desktop contrast notifications from the palette window, which lives until app shutdown.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Call on the palette window's UI thread; this captures its dispatcher for later settings notifications.</remarks>
```
